title: Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields
summary: We prove Donovan's conjecture over every algebraically closed field K of characteristic p > 0. For each fixed K and bound on defect-group order, blocks of finite groups represent only finitely many K -linear Morita equivalence classes. The defect groups need not be abelian, and the result includes p = 2.
family_title: Donovan's conjecture over fields and complete mixed-characteristic DVRs

review.reason: Proves Donovan's conjecture over algebraically closed fields of positive characteristic.
